records.summary: The selected STANDARD ABI is reconciled with the deployment-specific source record. Permanent cap reduction is burnedForever + ledgerRetired = HARD_CAP - maxSupply. Public burn/burnFrom reduce both token balances and the ceiling; CentralBank-only convertFrom burns balances without reducing the ceiling, while retire reduces the ceiling without moving balances. The launch holding-cap enabled flag is not the active result: active also resolves a nonzero Registry TAX_HOOK and reads its launchScheduleActive. Registry and PoolManager getters are address observations, not new callable targets.
limits: Review is scoped to this STANDARD deployment and selected read semantics; it does not verify the other five runtime roles or separately deployed dependencies.
Sourcify record evidence is not a fresh block-scoped observation, independent local source/bytecode equivalence proof, audit or transaction-success guarantee.
The verification-record timestamp is not an established source publication, deployment or feature-introduction date.
CentralBank usage descriptions in token comments do not establish the separate CentralBank implementation or its present policy.
Permanent totals do not attribute burns to buybacks, LP taxes or voluntary holders. Transfer-to-zero events also include conversion burns.

The holding cap checks destinations on transfers from PoolManager and source-defined exemptions; neither enabled nor active establishes that a particular trade, routed transfer or liquidity removal will succeed.
The PoolManager gate is independent of the inbound blocked-venue mapping. These scalar reads do not inspect that mapping or transient transfer budgets.

records.summary: The selected TaxHook ABI is reconciled with the deployment-specific source record. launchScheduleActive is false after a tax override, true when the decay start is zero, and otherwise true only before start plus duration; it is not inferred from displayed tax rates. The Hook uses this flag to reject non-POL liquidity additions during launch. pendingOwner is the proposed recipient of a two-step ownership transfer, not the current owner; zero represents no pending handoff.
